purpose: Teach: 宮内庁/日夜/儲ける/コネ/ドロップ/修習/総数/産婆

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、宮内庁の研究資料も参照しろ
lines.en: Ren — look into the Imperial Household Office research materials as well.
lines.style: Clipped, direct. No wasted words. Assumes compliance. Light weight on the name—establishing focus, not warmth. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。日夜、研究に励んでおります
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'm working on it day and night.
lines.style: Eager but controlled. Slight hurry underneath—wants to show commitment. Careful not to oversell. Respectful distance in the posture.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究で儲けるだけが目的ではない
lines.en: Ren — research isn't just about making money.
lines.style: Firmer. A light tap of correction, but not harsh. Slower than the last directive. The weight of something larger underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会のコネを活用させていただきます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll make use of my academic connections.
lines.style: Quick recovery. Showing he's absorbed the correction. Polite but not deflating. A note of genuine interest in what's being asked.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究テーマをドロップせず続けろ
lines.en: Ren — keep the research focus. Don't drop the thread.
lines.style: Direct and steady. Slightly lower in the register—this one lands differently. A reminder dressed as an order. Measured breath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。法学修習生の友人もおります
lines.en: Yes, sir. I have a friend who's a law apprentice—I can lean on their insight too.
lines.style: Warming slightly. He's understood the broader point and is responding with real thinking. Still respectful but more natural. Less mechanical.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、被験者の総数を明示しろ
lines.en: Ren — I need the exact number of research subjects documented.
lines.style: Sharp attention to detail. This one matters—the specificity lands like a rule. No ambiguity. Clinical precision in the delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究現場では産婆役のサポーターも大切です
lines.en: Yes, sir. The midwife role—the supporters who help the research happen—that's important too.
lines.style: Thoughtful closing. He's thinking past the immediate ask. Quieter, more reflective. A small breath before 'important.' Fading gently on the realization.
